title: Trees: Recursion & Validate Binary Search Tree

problems.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
problems.code:
class Solution:
    def isValidBST(self, root):
        self.prev = float('-inf')
        self.flag = True
        self.dfs(root)
        return self.flag

    def dfs(self, root):
        if not root: return
        self.dfs(root.left)
        if root.val <= self.prev: self.flag = False
        self.prev = root.val
        self.dfs(root.right)
problems.idea: In-order traversal must produce strictly increasing sequence. Track prev value with class variable. Any violation sets flag to False.

problems.title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
problems.code:
class Solution:
    def maxPathSum(self, root):
        self.maxSum = root.val
        def dfs(node):
            if not node: return 0
            l = max(dfs(node.left), 0)
            r = max(dfs(node.right), 0)
            self.maxSum = max(self.maxSum, l+r+node.val)
            return max(l, r) + node.val
        dfs(root)
        return self.maxSum
problems.idea: Post-order DFS. Clamp child sums to 0, check arch sum vs global max, return max single branch + val.

problems.title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
problems.code:
class Solution:
    def removeNthFromEnd(self, head, n):
        dummy=ListNode(0,head); slow=fast=dummy
        for _ in range(n+1): fast=fast.next
        while fast: slow,fast=slow.next,fast.next
        slow.next=slow.next.next
        return dummy.next
problems.idea: Dummy node + gap of n+1. Move fast n+1 steps, then both until fast is null. Skip slow.next.

problems.title: Product of Array Except Self
problems.code:
class Solution:
    def productExceptSelf(self, nums):
        n=len(nums); res=[1]*n
        for i in range(1,n): res[i]=res[i-1]*nums[i-1]
        r=1
        for i in range(n-1,-1,-1): res[i]*=r; r*=nums[i]
        return res
problems.idea: Two passes: left products in result array, then multiply by running right product in reverse.
